slot.brief: Evaluate two statements on ionisation enthalpy trends across a period and down a group; pick the correct combination.

stem:
Consider the following statements about first ionisation enthalpy:

Statement I: Across the second period, it increases strictly from Li to Ne.

Statement II: For the halogens, the order is F > Cl > Br > I.

Choose the correct combination.
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct.

verdicts.working: First ionisation enthalpy does not increase strictly from Li to Ne: it decreases from Be to B and from N to O. For halogens, it decreases down the group: F > Cl > Br > I.

working:
$\Delta_i H_1(\text{Be}) > \Delta_i H_1(\text{B})$ and $\Delta_i H_1(\text{N}) > \Delta_i H_1(\text{O})$: Statement I is false.\nDown group 17, first ionisation enthalpy decreases: $\text{F} > \text{Cl} > \text{Br} > \text{I}$; Statement II is true.

Independent check: First ionisation enthalpy does not increase strictly from Li to Ne: it decreases from Be to B and from N to O. For halogens, it decreases down the group: F > Cl > Br > I.
